name: RuleInfluencePanel

states.name: Rule Influence Overview
states.description: Users need to see which generation rules are ineffective, with load counts and prevention rates, to decide which rules should be disabled or improved.

states.name: Rule Effectiveness Ratio
states.description: Users need a clear effectiveness ratio for each rule to quickly assess which rules contribute value.

states.name: High No-Effect Warning Badges
states.description: Rules with high no-effect counts are flagged with an orange warning badge.

states.name: Loading and Empty States
states.description: Empty state communicates that all rules appear healthy.

states.name: Rule Data Rendering
states.description: Each rule row must accurately render the rule ID (first 16 chars, monospace), total loaded count, no-effect count, prevented-error count, and calculated effectiveness ratio.

states.name: Rule State Transitions
states.description: The panel transitions between loading, error, empty ('All rules appear effective'), and populated states without visual glitches.
states.precondition: No rules meet the ineffectiveness threshold (this is the healthy state)

description: Rule Influence Panel — identifies generation rules that have been loaded many times without measurable positive effect, helping developers prune ineffective rules that waste prompt tokens.
